Your name here turns blue and you will be the envy of your peers (plus you have an awesome project at the end of it 😄 ) ^ lets do the replies in a discord thread so they stay contained i intend to participate in CDAP Cohort 1 what do you mean by the phrase "i intend to participate" is this for people who have already been accepted? or is this for people *want* to be accepted? The program is "open" meaning that anyone may participate that chooses to do so. The "accepted" part only has to do with whether you will be offered funding. Some people will choose to participate independent of funding, either because they don't need it, or simply because they are interested and able.
